gap: The near cards are flat, evenly lit matte planes: no sheen from the bright window right beside them, no curl or lifted corner and no shadow on the floor, so they read as floating cut-outs rather than glossy instant photos in that light.
notes: Strong room: warm floor beams with mullion shadows, dust, bright right-wall windows, good near/far depth with undeveloped far cards; every held card sits right of centre, fully in frame and clear of the copy; no console errors or failed chapters. Secondary: (1) herbarium photo is cropped so its heading reads 'barium Project' (and 'Go to Main M' at right); anchor the crop left. (2) HaoJia and PetAid riso cards: the pink/blue ink block hangs far below its text line (the text rides the block's top edge) and the bottom third is empty, so they look unfinished next to the photo cards. (3) BuildUp's TOP 5 stamp renders the 5 as a broken glyph. (4) kacha's photo is ~80% blank beige around a small camera icon; crop tighter. (5) Entry frame v5.8: a sun glare with a horizontal streak and bright haze sit over the caption column while the header fades in, so it reads washed out. (6) Cards pass very close to the lens on exit (v8.17, v10.15), filling the right third with a soft, upscaled slab.
